item.title: 16-Player Social Deduction Game Free to Keep on PC Until November 1
item.description:
PC gamers can claim another freebie from the Epic Games Store and keep it forever as long as they claim it before November 1. The Epic Games Store is already offering several free games for users to claim right now, including some spooky titles perfect for the Halloween season. Gamers looking for a fun social deduction experience to enjoy with up to 15 other players can add Mafia Hotel to their Epic Games library for a limited time.

The Epic Games Store's free game offerings have become a long-running tradition as the platform aims to compete with PC storefront rival Steam. Although the company has come under fire from some users recently for an AI vibe-coded update to the Epic Games launcher, it's hard to beat the low price of free when trying to grow a library of PC games. As such, PC gamers have a number of good reasons to log into the Epic Games Store before these free game deals expire.

item.title: Pokemon Pokopia Proves the Best Spin-Offs Offer More Than Catching Them All
item.description:
For decades, the Pokemon franchise has revolved around catching Pokemon, training a team, and battling other trainers. That formula has helped make the series one of gaming's most recognizable names, but some of its most memorable games have found ways to make Pokemon appealing without relying on traditional battles. Pokemon Pokopia takes this idea further than ever, turning the familiar creatures into neighbors, collaborators, and companions in a cozy life simulation. Rather than asking players to become the strongest Trainer, it encourages them to build a world where Pokemon can thrive together.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

This approach has a long history in the franchise. Pokemon Mystery Dungeon showed that Pokemon could carry an emotional adventure of their own, while Pokemon Snap made observing them in their natural habitats the central attraction. Each series gives players a different way to connect with creatures that they might otherwise view primarily as battle partners. Pokemon Pokopia builds on that tradition, and its success as a creative direction could offer some valuable lessons for the mainline games.

All Pokemon Locations in Pokopia (Complete Pokedex)

There are 304 Pokemon in Pokemon Pokopia. Here's where you can find them all.

By Tom Bowen

Pokemon Pokopia Makes Living With Pokemon the Main Attraction

In Pokemon Pokopia , players control a Ditto that has transformed into a human and sets out to restore a desolate world. The game replaces the usual journey through Gyms and rival battles with crafting, gardening, and building habitats that encourage Pokemon to settle in. Pokemon can even teach Ditto moves that serve practical purposes, such as using Bulbasaur's Leafage to grow greenery or Squirtle's Water Gun to water plants. These abilities give familiar moves a different purpose, turning Pokemon into active participants in rebuilding their surroundings.

What makes this concept appealing is how naturally it changes the relationship between players and Pokemon. Instead of catching a creature because it fills a gap in a battle team, players can welcome it because it contributes something to their growing community. Creating a suitable habitat becomes a way to encourage Pokemon to visit, while building homes gives players another reason to care about who lives nearby. Pokemon Pokopia demonstrates that the creatures can remain the heart of the experience even when battling is removed entirely. The franchise has plenty of room to explore what it means to share a world with Pokemon, and this life simulation offers a particularly inviting interpretation.

Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Proves Pokemon Can Tell Their Own Stories

Long before Pokemon Pokopia , Pokemon Mystery Dungeon explored a different way to put Pokemon at the center of an adventure. The series casts players as Pokemon themselves, with dungeon exploration and turn-based combat replacing the traditional Trainer journey. Its battles still matter, but the story gives the creatures personalities, relationships, and motivations that extend beyond their usefulness in a team. In Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky , the relationship between the protagonist, their partner, and Grovyle becomes the foundation of a story about friendship, sacrifice, and the future of the world.

I still feel betrayed whenever I see Dusknoir because of Pokemon Mystery Dungeon . His role in Explorers of Sky makes him a particularly memorable example of how much personality the franchise can give its Pokemon. Initially, Dusknoir presents himself as a helpful ally, but his connection to the future and his eventual betrayal of Grovyle reveal a far more complicated character. And he’s literally a Dusknoir. That revelation works because the game gives players time to trust him before pulling the rug out from under them. Dusknoir becomes more than a recognizable species or a powerful opponent; he is a character whose actions leave a lasting impression.

Pokemon Snap Makes Observing Pokemon Rewarding

Pokemon Snap takes an even more focused approach by making photography the central mechanic. Rather than catching Pokemon in Poke Balls or battling them into submission, players travel through carefully designed environments and photograph creatures as they go about their lives. New Pokemon Snap expands on this idea with different habitats and a research-focused Photodex, encouraging players to notice how Pokemon behave in the wild. A successful photograph depends on finding the right moment, which can mean watching a Pokemon interact with another creature or catching an unusual pose.

This perspective gives familiar Pokemon a different kind of appeal. A creature that players might normally value for its battle strength can become fascinating simply because of how it behaves in its environment. Photographing Pokemon encourages curiosity, patience, and attention to detail, qualities that traditional battles do not necessarily reward. The experience also reinforces the idea that Pokemon have lives beyond their interactions with Trainers. Pokemon Snap succeeds because it builds its entire identity around that observation, proving that a spin-off can feel unmistakably like Pokemon without reproducing the mainline games' core gameplay loop.

Mainline Pokemon Games Could Learn From These Spin-Offs

The mainline games do not need to abandon catching, battling, or collecting to benefit from these ideas. Those mechanics are central to the franchise's identity, and there is still plenty of room to develop them. However, Pokemon Pokopia , Pokemon Mystery Dungeon , and Pokemon Snap demonstrate how much more the series can do with its creatures. The mainline games could give Pokemon more opportunities to interact with their environments, behave in distinctive ways outside battle, or contribute to the world in ways that players can appreciate directly. Even relatively small additions could help make each Pokemon feel like a living creature rather than another entry on a team-building checklist.

There is also an opportunity to make the world itself more meaningful. Pokemon Pokopia ties its progression to creating places where Pokemon want to live, while Pokemon Snap rewards players for learning about their behavior. Pokemon Mystery Dungeon builds emotional investment through its characters and their relationships. Mainline entries could draw from these strengths without turning into life simulations or story-driven dungeon crawlers. Imagine a Pokemon journey in which helping local species restore a habitat matters as much as defeating a Gym Leader, or where a Pokemon's behavior outside battle gives players another reason to bond with it. These ideas would complement the existing formula rather than replace it, making the world feel richer and the Pokemon within it more memorable.

What To Read Next
Pokemon Pokopia Just Gave Minecraft's Best Storage Trick a Cozy Makeover
Pokemon Pokopia Is Becoming the Animal Crossing Game Switch 2 Doesn't Have Yet
Pokemon Bank's Shutdown Is a Bigger Problem Than Losing an Old 3DS App

Pokemon Pokopia is another reminder that the franchise's greatest strength is the creatures themselves, not any single mechanic associated with them. Pokemon Mystery Dungeon made me care about a betrayal involving Dusknoir, while Pokemon Snap showed how rewarding it can be to simply watch Pokemon exist in their natural environments. Now, Pokemon Pokopia lets players build a place where those creatures can live and flourish. The mainline games can continue to build on their established formula, but they should also take these spin-offs seriously as sources of inspiration. Catching them all will always be part of Pokemon 's appeal. Giving players more reasons to care about the Pokemon they find could make the series even better.

9 /10

item.title: MW4 DMZ: Gun Store Weapons Locker Location
item.description:
Modern Warfare 4 DMZ includes a plethora of locked loot that you can only get with the right key. For the Gun Store Weapons Lockers, you'll need the Gun Store Weapons Locker Key, and if you're lucky enough to get one, then you can find out where to use it here before someone kills you and takes the key for themselves!

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover
MW4 DMZ: Counting Room Vault Key Location

The Counting Room Vault is filled with exciting loot in MW4 DMZ. Here's where you can find it (and how to open it).

By Jake Fillery

Gun Store Weapons Locker Locations in MW4 DMZ

Cheongun Village

The Gun Store Weapons in the Cheongun Village are located in the building to the left of the Police Station , as shown on the map above, noted by the winking mascot with the gun.

Enter the building we've shown, and you can head downstairs to find the Gun Store Weapons Lockers . Some of the lockers are already accessible, but there will be three that require a key. Using your Gun Store Weapons Key will only work on one of the lockers, but the loot is randomly generated once opened, so it really doesn't matter which of the three you pick.

There are also Gun Store Weapon Lockers in Songdo Wharf, which we'll show below, as these will be safer to reach. The Cheongun Village is usually quite hostile with enemy operators due to the Heavenly Luck Casino being a hot spot for PvP.

Songdo Wharf

The Gun Store Weapons in Songdo Wharf is in the furthest north building, to the left of the gas station , as shown on the map above. Here, you will find the right building by looking for the winking mascot holding a gun.

Once you are inside, head to the back room on the right to a set of stairs, where you will find more gun lockers to open. Remember, the Gun Store Weapons Locker Key will only open ONE of these lockers, so make sure you choose wisely! Just like Cheongun Village, the loot will involve a gun (usually Rare) and, if you're lucky, a weapon manual or recipe .

item.title: Call of Duty: MW4 Players Are Not Happy About the TTK
item.description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has only been officially out for a day, and some players are already fed up with the game's time to kill. Like the entries before it, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 puts heavy emphasis on its PvP multiplayer mode, alongside its other offerings like a single-player campaign and co-op mode. As such, balancing the gameplay of MW4 's multiplayer is high on the priority list for many series fans, who are now calling for the TTK to be lowered.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

The latest entry in Activision's illustrious FPS franchise is off to a generally strong start, currently sitting at a "Very Positive" Steam rating and an 85 OpenCritic score. Critics and players alike have praised Modern Warfare 4 's campaign for its compelling story and a complete multiplayer package with modes like Gun Game and DMZ available at launch. This doesn't mean there aren't some gameplay systems that need tweaking, with TTK emerging as an obvious candidate for a post-launch patch.

Best Meta M4 Loadout in COD Modern Warfare 4

This meta M4 loadout is shredding the competition in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, particularly in Kill Block. Here are the attachments you need.

By Nathan Round

Modern Warfare 4 Fans Are Calling for a Lower Time to Kill

In shooter games like Call of Duty , Time to Kill (or TTK) is the time it takes for a player to completely eliminate an opponent after firing the first shot. Typically, a lower TTK means that enemies die quicker, while a higher TTK means it takes longer to kill an enemy. Currently, Modern Warfare 4 players feel like the game's TTK is too high for an Infinity Ward game, considering the previous Modern Warfare reboot entries had a much lower TTK.

A post on the Modern Warfare 4 subreddit by user TheRealConJr laments the game's high TTK, saying that it almost feels as bad as Black Ops 4 . While Treyarch-developed Call of Duty games tend to have higher TTKs, Infinity Ward is known for its faster-paced, lower TTK gameplay. Comments on user TheRealConJr's post share a similar sentiment, expressing confusion at why the TTK was seemingly changed from the Modern Warfare 4 beta to its full release and complaining that everyone is using the Oris 8.6 marksman rifle since it has a one-shot kill.

Furthermore, other Reddit users are also expressing their frustration with Modern Warfare 4 's TTD, or Time to Death, in addition to its TTK. As opposed to TTK, TTD is the time it takes for the player to be killed after getting hit by the first shot. The major difference between TTK and TTD comes from the netcode that Call of Duty games use, where players with a better connection to the server can experience a lower TTD but a higher TTK, often feeling like they are dead before they can even react to being shot at. The result can make Call of Duty matches feel incredibly one-sided or even sluggish to play, especially for a series that prides itself on fast-paced, almost arcade-like shooter gameplay.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Shipment Release Date Officially Confirmed

Aside from the controversy surrounding the latest Call of Duty 's TTK, other players are taking issue with Modern Warfare 4 's skill-based matchmaking. Modern Warfare 4 players are reportedly having a tough time retaining their K/D ratios due to an unbalanced matchmaking system that puts them with increasingly hardcore players the better they perform in a match. Some of these multiplayer-centric controversies can be attributed to launch weekend hiccups that will be ironed out with future Modern Warfare 4 patches, so it will be interesting to see how Infinity Ward addresses TTK going forward.

As such, balancing the gameplay of MW4 's multiplayer is high on the priority list for many series fans, who are now calling for the TTK to be lowered.

The latest entry in Activision's illustrious FPS franchise is off to a generally strong start, currently sitting at a "Very Positive" Steam rating and an 85 OpenCritic score. Critics and players alike have praised Modern Warfare 4 's campaign for its compelling story and a complete multiplayer package with modes like Gun Game and DMZ available at launch. This doesn't mean there aren't some gameplay systems that need tweaking, with TTK emerging as an obvious candidate for a post-launch patch.

By Nathan Round

Modern Warfare 4 Fans Are Calling for a Lower Time to Kill

In shooter games like Call of Duty , Time to Kill (or TTK) is the time it takes for a player to completely eliminate an opponent after firing the first shot. Typically, a lower TTK means that enemies die quicker, while a higher TTK means it takes longer to kill an enemy. Currently, Modern Warfare 4 players feel like the game's TTK is too high for an Infinity Ward game, considering the previous Modern Warfare reboot entries had a much lower TTK.

A post on the Modern Warfare 4 subreddit by user TheRealConJr laments the game's high TTK, saying that it almost feels as bad as Black Ops 4 . While Treyarch-developed Call of Duty games tend to have higher TTKs, Infinity Ward is known for its faster-paced, lower TTK gameplay. Comments on user TheRealConJr's post share a similar sentiment, expressing confusion at why the TTK was seemingly changed from the Modern Warfare 4 beta to its full release and complaining that everyone is using the Oris 8.6 marksman rifle since it has a one-shot kill.

Furthermore, other Reddit users are also expressing their frustration with Modern Warfare 4 's TTD, or Time to Death, in addition to its TTK. As opposed to TTK, TTD is the time it takes for the player to be killed after getting hit by the first shot. The major difference between TTK and TTD comes from the netcode that Call of Duty games use, where players with a better connection to the server can experience a lower TTD but a higher TTK, often feeling like they are dead before they can even react to being shot at. The result can make Call of Duty matches feel incredibly one-sided or even sluggish to play, especially for a series that prides itself on fast-paced, almost arcade-like shooter gameplay.

Aside from the controversy surrounding the latest Call of Duty 's TTK, other players are taking issue with Modern Warfare 4 's skill-based matchmaking. Modern Warfare 4 players are reportedly having a tough time retaining their K/D ratios due to an unbalanced matchmaking system that puts them with increasingly hardcore players the better they perform in a match. Some of these multiplayer-centric controversies can be attributed to launch weekend hiccups that will be ironed out with future Modern Warfare 4 patches, so it will be interesting to see how Infinity Ward addresses TTK going forward.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is Already a Big Hit
item.description:
Final Fantasy Resonance is already off to a strong start on Steam, as the game has achieved a peak player count of over 38,000 and rising just over a day into its release window. Final Fantasy Resonance is an HD-2D title that uses a similar graphical style as the Octopath Traveler series.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

The main story of Final Fantasy Resonance is a retelling of the first major story arc of Final Fantasy Brave Exvius , a mobile title that was shut down in 2025. Developed by Square Enix's Creative Studio 5 and Lancarse, Final Fantasy Resonance features a turn-based combat system, rather than the series' traditional Active Time Battle mechanic. Additionally, Final Fantasy Resonanc e features popular franchise characters such as Cloud and Squall as collectible Visions that can aid the party in battle and teach them new abilities.

Final Fantasy Resonance's Player Count is Nothing Short of Impressive

As of this writing, Final Fantasy Resonance had a peak Steam player count of 38,182, which was set during the morning of Saturday, October 24. Final Fantasy Resonance 's peak Steam player count is currently the third-highest total for the Final Fantasy franchise, behind Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth and Final Fantasy 14 . By comparison, Rebirth 's peak count of 40,564 was set during the launch of the Steam port in January 2025, while FF14 's peak Steam count of 95,150 was achieved during the launch of the Endwalker expansion in December 2021.

Along with its rising player count, Final Fantasy Resonance currently holds an overwhelmingly positive Steam rating of 97% across 1,517 player reviews worldwide, making it the highest-rated entry in the Final Fantasy series on Steam so far. Some reviews compared Final Fantasy Resonance 's turn-based combat system to Final Fantasy 10 , where each unit's abilities and spells can alter the flow of battle. Others stated that, while the user interface and graphical style may not be for everyone, Resonance 's combat feels both familiar and new thanks to the Visions that players can discover throughout the world map.

The launch of Final Fantasy Resonance came amid a busy slate for the Final Fantasy series. Starting October 28, a crossover between the Final Fantasy 7 Remake series and Final Fantasy 14 will kick off with a limited-time activity called Keybound Brawler that will be held within FF14 's Manderville Gold Saucer. Participating players can earn cosmetic rewards, including glamour sets based on Tifa's and Barret's outfits from FF7 Remake , until the launch of FF14 's upcoming Evercold expansion. More information about Evercold , including a potential release date, will be discussed during Tokyo FanFest throughout Halloween weekend.

Aside from Steam, Final Fantasy Resonance is also available on all current-gen consoles, including Nintendo Switch 2, with physical and digital editions now available for purchase. With momentum continuing to build, it remains to be seen how many more players Final Fantasy Resonance will gain throughout its opening weekend.
